body.overview:
Clayox helps early childhood education centres run admissions, attendance, daily care updates, family messaging, and invoice-first billing from one platform. Each centre gets a dedicated deployment so operations stay organised without juggling spreadsheets and disconnected tools.

For the complete product experience, visit Clayox childcare management software. That is the primary Clayox website. This IGENTX page is only a concise summary for people exploring our products.

Pricing is US$1 per student per month and includes all features, a professional centre website (design and hosting on a free centre.clayox.com subdomain; custom domains are extra), and a 24/7 AI enquiry chat assistant whose chats admins review. The interface is English, with AI message translation into 100+ languages including Arabic. Billing supports AED and VAT.

Clayox is a progressive web app today, not a native mobile app, and there is no online payment gateway yet. If you want help planning a rollout alongside a centre website or AI enquiry work, book a free consultation with IGENTX.
